title: Have one agent pass your business numbers to your bookkeeper agent
summary: A business owner says his Grok-based ops agent now sends one company's finances to his ChatGPT agent, which keeps his personal and business books.
agent_role: An operations agent gathers and sends the business's financial figures; a second agent keeps the books. The owner approved the setup.
outcome: Author says this replaced work he used to do himself in spreadsheets a few months earlier.
what_they_did: The poster runs an operations agent called Carl, built on Grok, for his business Badass Breaks. Carl now sends that business's finances to Max, a ChatGPT agent. Max keeps his personal books and another business's books. He signed off on the handoff on October 14.
how_it_went: He says a few months ago he did all this in spreadsheets himself, and he finds the agent-to-agent handoff a little wild.
prompt: Each week, collect the income and expense figures for [business name] from [your sales and expense sources]. Put them in a simple summary: date, item, category, amount. Then prepare that summary for my bookkeeping assistant in the format [it expects, e.g. a spreadsheet]. Show me the summary first and wait for my approval before sending or recording anything. Flag any numbers that look unusual or missing.

curation.rationale: A genuine small-business bookkeeping handoff between two agents on different platforms, but very thin on detail and results; small non-coding boost applied.
